n39dce220b4.headline: Yen faces challenges, Eurozone retail sales disappoint
n39dce220b4.summary: EURJPY rose for a sixth straight session, trading near 172.80. Eurozone retail sales grew 2.2% year on year in July, below the expected 2.4%, and fell 0.5% month on month against a forecast 0.2% decline.
n39dce220b4.why: EUR/JPY compares the euro and the yen, two major currencies whose exchange rate affects European exporters, Japanese importers and carry-trade positioning. Eurozone retail sales is a key gauge of consumer spending in the bloc.

nfe4f57e2cf.headline: Amazon reveals UK revenues jump as it pays £1bn tax bill
nfe4f57e2cf.summary: Amazon reported a jump in UK revenues as it paid a £1bn tax bill. The company had faced criticism for not paying corporation tax in 2021 and 2022.
nfe4f57e2cf.why: Amazon is a US-based e-commerce and cloud company, and its UK tax and revenue trends draw regulatory and political scrutiny in its largest European market.

na37ce6be0c.headline: Aldi bringing in huge change at 600 stores to make customers lives easier
na37ce6be0c.summary: Over 500 Aldi UK stores now host InPost Lockers, letting shoppers collect and return online orders at their local store.
na37ce6be0c.why: Aldi is a major discount supermarket chain, and InPost is a European parcel-locker network that competes in last-mile delivery.

nca6d19cc42.headline: Labour could 'equalise' Capital Gains Tax with income tax in big shake-up
nca6d19cc42.summary: The Trades Union Congress wants higher taxes on the wealthy and says Labour could equalise capital gains tax with income tax in a major overhaul. The proposal is presented as a possible shake-up.
nca6d19cc42.why: Capital gains tax and income tax rates shape investment returns and government revenue, which matter for UK asset holders and fiscal policy.

n23580f497c.headline: India's tax cut on solar and wind devices to lower clean energy tariff, experts say
n23580f497c.summary: India's decision to cut taxes on solar and wind equipment will lower costs for new plants, experts say. It is expected to pressure existing developers to reduce tariffs.
n23580f497c.why: Tax and tariff changes on renewable equipment shape project economics for developers, equipment makers and power buyers in India's clean energy build-out.

n3f8f21f704.headline: London Underground workers to walk out on strike
n3f8f21f704.summary: London Underground workers are set to walk out on strike, a move that could cause significant disruption across the network.
n3f8f21f704.why: Strikes on a major transit network affect commuter spending, city productivity and the operator's costs in the UK capital.

ne1194d730b.headline: Iraq-Oman Business Forum highlights Investment Opportunities | Iraq Business News
ne1194d730b.summary: Iraqi Prime Minister Mohammed Shia Al-Sudani attended the Iraq-Oman Business Forum in Salalah with a ministerial delegation. The event followed the signing of 24 memoranda of understanding and two agreements.
ne1194d730b.why: Business forums and cooperation agreements between Gulf neighbours can shape trade and investment flows, particularly in energy and infrastructure.

source.name: Iraq Business News | All the latest business news from Iraq

sources.name: Iraq Business News | All the latest business news from Iraq

na6be23418f.headline: GST 2.0: Salted popcorn to attract 5 pc, caramel-flavoured 18 pc
na6be23418f.summary: The GST Council has set 5 per cent GST on popcorn mixed with salt and spices under the GST 2.0 regime, whether sold loose or pre-packaged. Caramel-flavoured popcorn will attract 18 per cent.
na6be23418f.why: India's Goods and Services Tax sets consumer prices across categories, so rate changes affect retailers and food makers.

ne62025adc0.headline: Scale meets precision: PM Modi, Ishiba and India–Japan compact (IANS Special)
ne62025adc0.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi's recent visit to Japan is described as a strategic inflection point in India-Japan ties, with a sweeping Joint Vision for the partnership. The visit covers political, technological and economic cooperation.
ne62025adc0.why: India and Japan are major Asian economies, and their closer ties affect trade, investment and supply-chain planning in the region.

n823cdbfe0b.headline: Common man will get major relief: Laghu Udyog Bharati of Jodhpur welcomes GST 2.0 reforms
n823cdbfe0b.summary: Laghu Udyog Bharati of Jodhpur welcomed GST 2.0 reforms approved at the 56th GST Council meeting. Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman announced the changes, which aim to simplify the tax structure.
n823cdbfe0b.why: The GST Council sets India's goods and services tax rules, and changes to the tax structure affect business costs and consumer prices across sectors.

n6e7721b775.headline: Sanofi Shares Plunge After Disappointing Amlitelimab Study Results (Updated)
n6e7721b775.summary: Sanofi shares fell sharply after phase 3 COAST 1 trial results for amlitelimab in adults and adolescents with atopic dermatitis were published. Analysts criticised the results.
n6e7721b775.why: Sanofi is a Paris-based pharmaceutical company, and its drug pipeline results can significantly change its valuation and investor expectations.

impacts.why: Shares tumbled after disappointing phase 3 trial results for amlitelimab.

n0e93388399.headline: Ikea's first New Zealand store to open on December 4
n0e93388399.summary: Ikea's first New Zealand store is set to open on December 4. Ikea expansion manager Fabian Winterbine described the expansion as quite a journey.
n0e93388399.why: IKEA is a global furniture retailer, and new store openings signal expansion into new retail markets.

n39a229f4b2.headline: Claire's Closing 235 Stores Amid Bankruptcy
n39a229f4b2.summary: Claire's is closing 235 stores amid its second bankruptcy in seven years. The company sold part of its business to Ames Watson, pausing some liquidations, including 56 Icing stores.
n39a229f4b2.why: Claire's is a US accessories retailer, and store closures and bankruptcy proceedings affect its creditors and the retail sector.

n02960dabb1.headline: Thailand's Thaksin Shinawatra faces a political reckoning as Pheu Thai reels
n02960dabb1.summary: A Pheu Thai lawmaker resigned from the ruling party in early September, reflecting what Reuters describes as the extraordinary decline of the party's most prominent figure, Thaksin Shinawatra.
n02960dabb1.why: Thailand's ruling coalition shapes fiscal and economic policy, and political instability can affect investor sentiment toward Thai assets.

n8401af43a7.headline: Chinese hotpot chain Haidilao reports $44M Vietnam revenue in H1 - VnExpress International
n8401af43a7.summary: Chinese hotpot chain Haidilao reported revenue of VND1.15 trillion (US$44 million) in Vietnam for the first half of the year, up 1.6% year on year.
n8401af43a7.why: Haidilao is a Chinese restaurant chain listed in Hong Kong, and its regional performance shows the health of its overseas expansion.

source.name: VnExpress International – Latest news, business, travel and analysis from Vietna

sources.name: VnExpress International – Latest news, business, travel and analysis from Vietna

na3f3a99947.headline: 'End of the reign': Decades-long Pākiri sand mining battle ends as company eyes up new location
na3f3a99947.summary: A decades-long dispute over sand mining at Pākiri has ended, and the company is looking at a new location. Local opposition in Bream Bay is expected to continue.
na3f3a99947.why: Sand is an input for construction, and mining consents and local opposition can determine whether quarry operators can keep producing.

n9305a3c1ff.headline: U.S. Department of Labor Recovers $520 Million Lost to Pandemic Unemployment Fraud
n9305a3c1ff.summary: The U.S. Department of Labor has recovered $520 million lost to pandemic unemployment fraud. The recovery reduces losses from benefit programs that were exploited during the pandemic.
n9305a3c1ff.why: Pandemic-era unemployment programs were a major source of federal spending, and recoveries affect how much public money was lost to fraud.

n901dd704d1.headline: Evergy says federal changes won’t affect planned solar projects in Kansas and Missouri
n901dd704d1.summary: Evergy says federal changes will not affect solar projects approved in Kansas and Missouri. The projects will generate electricity for customers in time to qualify for existing tax credits.
n901dd704d1.why: Evergy is a utility serving Kansas and Missouri, and its solar build-out depends on federal tax credits.

source.name: KCUR - Kansas City news and NPR

sources.name: KCUR - Kansas City news and NPR

n2b54d8cee9.headline: Hot economic growth may place further rate cuts on ice
n2b54d8cee9.summary: Reserve Bank governor Michele Bullock has signalled there may not be many more interest rate cuts to come, given hot economic growth.
n2b54d8cee9.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the country's cash rate, which drives borrowing costs, bond yields and the Australian dollar.

nff560c88b4.headline: Is Australia's promised green hydrogen industry ever going to happen?
nff560c88b4.summary: Billions of dollars in private investment are being pulled out of green hydrogen projects, raising doubts about Australia's promised industry.
nff560c88b4.why: Green hydrogen is a low-emission fuel that depends heavily on large upfront investment and government support.

nc883742002.headline: RBA’s Bullock hints fewer cuts ahead as spending surges, GBP/AUD extends lower
nc883742002.summary: RBA Governor Michele Bullock hinted at fewer interest-rate cuts ahead as spending surges. The Australian dollar held firm among FX performers this week on upbeat economic data.
nc883742002.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate that anchors Australian borrowing costs, bond yields and the Australian dollar.

impacts.why: Signals of fewer rate cuts tend to support the currency by keeping Australian interest rates higher for longer.

n51f3b07871.headline: A snapshot of Malaysia's economic performance in Q2 2025
n51f3b07871.summary: Malaysia's economic growth in the second quarter of 2025 was mainly supported by the services sector on the supply side. Private consumption and investment were the key demand drivers.
n51f3b07871.why: Quarterly GDP data show the pace and drivers of growth in an economy, informing central-bank policy and investor views on the ringgit and Malaysian equities.

n6968119418.headline: French Socialists confirm they’ll oust PM, push for center-left replacement
n6968119418.summary: French Socialists confirmed they will oust Prime Minister François Bayrou and push for a centre-left replacement. The article notes there is little hope left for his minority government.
n6968119418.why: France's government budget and political stability influence French government bond yields and the CAC 40 index, a key Eurozone equity benchmark.
n6968119418.why_moved: Socialists confirmed they will oust Prime Minister Bayrou, whose minority government has little remaining support, raising French political uncertainty.

nc7bff38402.headline: America's Car-Mart:  Fiscal Q1 Earnings Snapshot
nc7bff38402.summary: America's Car-Mart reported a loss of $5.7 million in its fiscal first quarter. The Rogers, Arkansas-based used-car retailer reported the loss on Thursday.
nc7bff38402.why: America's Car-Mart is a US used-vehicle retailer that sells cars with in-house financing to subprime customers.

n6a1542a6ad.headline: Google fined 325 mln euros in France over tracker breaches
n6a1542a6ad.summary: France's data protection authority fined Google 325 million euros for failing to comply with regulations on online trackers, according to Xinhua.
n6a1542a6ad.why: Alphabet's Google is a dominant online advertising platform, and EU privacy enforcement can constrain how it collects user data for advertising revenue.

n354812dc42.headline: Will taxes in Germany increase to fill the 30 billion euro gap?
n354812dc42.summary: Germany faces a budget gap of around 30 billion euros, and the article asks whether taxes will rise to fill it. No government decision is described in the input.
n354812dc42.why: Germany is the euro area's largest economy, and its fiscal decisions influence government bond yields and the eurozone growth outlook. Tax changes affect corporate and household spending.

n435e20951f.headline: Gold hits record Rs376,000 per tola
n435e20951f.summary: Gold in Pakistan reached a record Rs376,000 per tola, an increase of Rs5,144. Silver prices also rose.
n435e20951f.why: Gold is a traditional store of value, and local gold prices in Pakistan move with international bullion prices and the rupee exchange rate.

ne5a7713731.headline: Zydus and Synthon entered into exclusive licensing and supply agreement for Ozanimod Capsules for the U.S. market
ne5a7713731.summary: Zydus Lifesciences Global FZE has entered an exclusive licensing and supply agreement with Synthon BV of the Netherlands. The deal covers generic Ozanimod capsules, a version of ZEPOSIA, for the US market.
ne5a7713731.why: Zydus Lifesciences is an Indian pharmaceutical company, and generic drug licensing deals in the US market affect its revenue and pipeline.

n72a4a1fdb2.headline: Samhwa Secures Investment from KKR to Drive Next Chapter of Growth
n72a4a1fdb2.summary: TPG completed the sale of Samhwa to KKR following a successful partnership, marking the start of the next growth phase for the company.
n72a4a1fdb2.why: KKR is a global private equity firm, and TPG is another major private equity investor, so this deal shows private capital changing hands in Korean assets.

n35881a77b3.headline: Dollar drifts as cracks in US labour market spur rate cut bets
n35881a77b3.summary: The U.S. dollar steadied in a volatile week as investors weighed bond market jitters and data showing a weakening labour market, reinforcing rate-cut expectations.
n35881a77b3.why: The dollar is the world's main reserve currency, and its moves shape global capital flows, commodity prices and emerging-market borrowing costs.

nf7d6af7fe5.headline: Rithm Capital adds $17B in assets with Crestline acquisition
nf7d6af7fe5.summary: Rithm Capital, parent of mortgage lender Newrez, struck a $17 billion deal to acquire Crestline, adding $17 billion in assets.
nf7d6af7fe5.why: Rithm Capital is a New York-based real estate and mortgage investment company whose acquisitions expand its asset base and lending business.

n5ed12fe424.headline: Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe prepares for trip to China  | Globalnews.ca
n5ed12fe424.summary: Saskatchewan Premier Scott Moe is preparing a trip to China. Farmers continue to feel pressure from Chinese tariffs on canola, with finances for many at stake.
n5ed12fe424.why: Chinese tariffs on Canadian canola have been a major trade dispute affecting prairie farm incomes.

n8eeb2c9ac6.headline: Champagne says 'adjustments' coming to the public service as Ottawa reviews spending
n8eeb2c9ac6.summary: Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne said adjustments are coming to the public service as Ottawa looks to trim spending in the fall budget. The government is reviewing its expenditures.
n8eeb2c9ac6.why: The federal budget sets government spending and deficit targets, which influence Canadian bond yields and the outlook for the broader economy.

na5d9d9b70d.headline: Canada must ‘reinvent’ economy like it did in 1945, finance minister says - National | Globalnews.ca
na5d9d9b70d.summary: Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne said government efforts will focus on using technology, delivering better services and ensuring value for money. He compared the task to the postwar economic reinvention of 1945.
na5d9d9b70d.why: Federal economic policy shapes public investment, productivity and fiscal priorities that matter for Canadian businesses and investors.

n8cdbc27b3c.headline: Auto sales in August post first annual decline since February: DesRosiers
n8cdbc27b3c.summary: DesRosiers Automotive Consultants estimates about 160,000 vehicles were sold in Canada in August, down 2 per cent. The firm said the market is showing stress from the broader economic slowdown and trade disputes.
n8cdbc27b3c.why: Auto sales are a key indicator of consumer demand and of the health of the automotive manufacturing and dealership sector.

n78ef72646a.headline: GST reforms a step to boost Atmanirbhar Bharat, contribute to India’s growth story: Piyush Goyal
n78ef72646a.summary: India’s Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal described recent GST reforms as a step to strengthen Atmanirbhar Bharat and contribute to India’s economic growth.
n78ef72646a.why: GST reforms impact tax structure and business environment in India, influencing economic growth and investment climate.

n08143a8eab.headline: Benin raises 33 billion FCFA from investors in the UEMOA financial market
n08143a8eab.summary: Benin raised 33 billion FCFA on September 4, 2025, on the UEMOA regional market at the close of its auction of 91-day Treasury bills. The issuance was to meet budgetary needs.
n08143a8eab.why: Regional West African Treasury bill auctions on the UEMOA market are a key funding source for member governments and set local short-term sovereign borrowing costs.
